Terms

The Echo Archives is a curated discovery site. Using the site means using it responsibly and not treating editorial content, ratings, or submission tools as an open publishing platform.

Use of the site

You may browse the archive, use discovery tools, and submit corrections, reviews, and verification requests. You may not use the site to spam, scrape abusively, interfere with service availability, or submit unlawful, deceptive, or malicious material.

Editorial independence

Archive ratings, archive notes, and collection placement are editorial decisions. Creator verification only signals metadata confirmation and does not imply creator approval of ratings, reviews, or curation choices.

User submissions

By sending a submission, you confirm that the information is accurate to the best of your knowledge and that you have the right to share it. Submissions are moderated and may be edited, declined, or held for follow-up instead of being published automatically.

Accuracy and availability

The archive aims for high-quality metadata and careful editorial work, but it cannot guarantee that every page is complete, current, or error-free at all times. Features and data may change without notice while the catalog evolves.

Links and external services

The site links to official show pages, listening platforms, and third-party services for convenience. The Echo Archives does not control those services and is not responsible for their content, uptime, or policies.

Intellectual property

Unless otherwise noted, the site design, archive copy, and original project materials belong to their respective rights holders. Podcast names, cover art, and related marks remain the property of their owners.
